source.title: Cal State LA hydrogen station operation and safety overview

procedure.action: pause filling and close the inlet valve for 5 seconds
procedure.acceptance: resume only when no measurable pressure drop is observed
procedure.claim_boundary: This is an operational description, not a complete SAE J2601 fueling-table specification or a universal leak-test acceptance limit.

schedule_fields.leak_check_pressure_interval_pa: optional pressure interval; None keeps continuous fill

verification.note: The procedure is implemented as an opt-in control behavior. It does not constitute independent experimental validation of the station thermodynamics.
